attributes.description: RDS DBLoad idle evidence. Not a Compute Optimizer rec.
attributes.visState: {"title": "RDS idle evidence: lowest DBLoad (not CPU; not a rec)", "type": "vega", "aggs": [], "params": {"spec": "{\"$schema\": \"https://vega.github.io/schema/vega-lite/v5.json\", \"description\": \"Lowest RDS DBLoad averages in the time picker. CPUUtilization is not ingested; DBLoad is the idle signal. Not a Compute Optimizer rec.\", \"autosize\": {\"type\": \"fit\", \"contains\": \"padding\"}, \"data\": {\"url\": {\"%type%\": \"esql\", \"%context%\": true, \"%timefield%\": \"@timestamp\", \"query\": \"FROM metrics-aws.rds-*\\n| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend\\n    AND aws.rds.metrics.DBLoad.avg IS NOT NULL\\n| STATS dbload_avg = ROUND(AVG(aws.rds.metrics.DBLoad.avg), 4), samples = COUNT(*)\\n    BY db = aws.dimensions.DBInstanceIdentifier, account = cloud.account.id\\n| SORT dbload_avg ASC\\n| LIMIT 20\"}}, \"encoding\": {\"y\": {\"field\": \"db\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"DB instance\", \"sort\": \"x\", \"axis\": {\"labelLimit\": 220, \"labelPadding\": 4, \"grid\": false}}, \"x\": {\"field\": \"dbload_avg\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"DBLoad avg\", \"axis\": {\"grid\": true, \"tickCount\": 5}}}, \"layer\": [{\"mark\": {\"type\": \"bar\", \"cornerRadiusEnd\": 3, \"tooltip\": true, \"height\": {\"band\": 0.72}}, \"encoding\": {\"color\": {\"field\": \"account\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Account\", \"legend\": {\"orient\": \"bottom\", \"columns\": 3}}, \"tooltip\": [{\"field\": \"db\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"DB instance\"}, {\"field\": \"account\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Account\"}, {\"field\": \"dbload_avg\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"DBLoad avg\", \"format\": \".4f\"}, {\"field\": \"samples\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Samples\"}]}}, {\"mark\": {\"type\": \"text\", \"align\": \"left\", \"baseline\": \"middle\", \"dx\": 4, \"fontSize\": 11, \"color\": \"#343741\"}, \"encoding\": {\"text\": {\"field\": \"dbload_avg\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"format\": \".4f\"}}}], \"config\": {\"view\": {\"stroke\": null}, \"axis\": {\"labelFontSize\": 11, \"titleFontSize\": 12, \"domain\": false}}}"}}
